fusions.name: Barbed Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Haul In
fusions.desc: Hauls you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then strikes for 13 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged Leap
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, and your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Barbs in the Wake
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
